build_convnext_model: build a ConvNeXt model with custom depths and dims for image classification
run_forward_features: run forward_features on a ConvNeXt model to extract pooled feature vectors
create_convnext_variant: create a ConvNeXt variant like tiny, small, base, or large using factory functions
update_drop_path: update the drop path rate dynamically on a trained ConvNeXt model
review_block_forward: review the ConvNeXt Block forward pass with depthwise conv and MLP
